name: control_plane_pages_lq223_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CONTROL_PLANE_PAGES_LQ223_20261107 — LQ-20261107-223: control-plane pages answer from their real stores.
identity projects IdentityRegistry@v1 entities (keyed, never by ticker); workflows skips a bounded number of
complete corrupt lines and reports skipped_corrupt_lines (a mostly corrupt file stays INVALID_SCHEMA); learning
rows carry the LearningEvidenceStatus keys; the office audit becomes dated claims; /system reports SERVING only
with a persistent-state root (an empty root is UNAVAILABLE, never LIVE); the r24 renderer never prints 'undefined'.
